title: [finding] README's `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm dev` serves no Console on a fresh clone: `/_console/` and `/` answer 404, and the boot warning names a remedy that does not exist in this repo
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing spot and a reproduction (`finding` class (a): the README's command sequence yields a 404 where the same README says the Console is; plus a boot message whose prescription is wrong for this repository).
reach: public entry measured once — after the README's three commands, `GET /_console/` on the showcase dev server answers `404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND"…}}` and `GET /` answers 404; after the undocumented `pnpm objectui:build` the same requests answer 200 and 302.
Reader: `domain:devx` seat for `README.md` (one line) and the boot warning's remedy text in the Console-mount code path (`packages/cli` / `plugin-hono-server`, whichever prints `Console dist not found — install @object-ui/console …`); the bare-404 half is `domain:cli`.
Dedup: `search_issues` "README pnpm dev Console dist not found fresh clone /_console/ 404 objectui:build step missing Hack on the framework" (open + closed) → 0 cards.
Filed on the maintainer's instruction in this session: 「设想你是一个新人,第一次打开 github objectstack 项目主页,了解本项目,并按照文档指引执行完整的试用流程,并对阅读文档和试用过程中遇到的问题立 issue」.

## Summary

The README's contributor on-ramp is three commands:

```bash
pnpm install     # Node 22+, pnpm 10 (corepack enable)
pnpm build       # build all packages
pnpm dev         # showcase example: REST + Console on :3000
```

On a fresh clone of `main` that sequence boots the showcase API but **no Console**. `packages/console/dist` is gitignored and `turbo run build` never produces it (by design — `scripts/check-console-sha.mjs` and `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx` both say so), so the step that actually produces the Console, `pnpm objectui:build`, is missing from the README. A newcomer who follows the README then opens `http://localhost:3000/_console/` (the URL the same README gives in **Try it in five minutes**) and gets a JSON 404.

Two smaller problems compound it:

1. **The boot-time warning names the wrong remedy for this repository.** The server prints
   `⚠ Console dist not found — install \`@object-ui/console\` (already built) or run \`pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build\` in the objectui workspace`.
   Neither instruction applies inside `objectstack-ai/objectstack`: `@object-ui/console` is not a dependency anyone installs here, and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` assumes a cwd inside the objectui workspace. The repo's own remedy is `pnpm objectui:build` (which `scripts/build-console.sh` resolves against a `../objectui` sibling or, failing that, a shallow clone into `.cache/`), and `pnpm check:console-sha` already prints exactly that line one step earlier. The two messages disagree on the same boot.
2. **The absence is not loud at the HTTP surface.** With no Console, `GET /` returns `404` with an empty body and `GET /_console/` returns `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}` — indistinguishable from a wrong URL. AGENTS.md's "Absence must be loud" rule asks for a composition that legitimately serves nothing to say so once, naming the remedy; here the remedy is only in the terminal, and it is the wrong one.

## Reproduction

Fresh clone of `main`, Node v22.22.0, pnpm 10.31.0.

```bash
pnpm install                        # 16 s
pnpm build                          # 72 turbo tasks, ~7 min, exit 0
ls packages/console/dist            # No such file or directory
pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38431        # README's `pnpm dev`, on a spare port
```

Boot output (abridged):

```text
ℹ No console dist at packages/console/dist — skipping SHA check. Build it with: pnpm objectui:build
…
  ⚠ Page source and `requires` not validated at save: no SDUI component manifest at …/examples/app-showcase/sdui.manifest.json or …/packages/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json …
  ⚠ Console dist not found — install `@object-ui/console` (already built) or run `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` in the objectui workspace
  ✓ Server is ready
  ➜  API:       http://localhost:38431/
  ➜  MCP:       http://localhost:38431/api/v1/mcp
```

(Note the `➜ Console:` line that a scaffolded project prints is absent — the only hint on the banner.)

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:38431/_console/   # 404 (application/json, ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND)
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:38431/            # 404
curl -s http://localhost:38431/api/v1/health                                # {"success":true,…}  — the API itself is fine
```

For contrast, a project scaffolded with `npm create objectstack@latest` serves `/_console/` (200, the SPA) out of the box because the published `@objectstack/cli` depends on the prebuilt `@objectstack/console` package.

The missing step itself works on a fresh machine with no `../objectui` checkout: `pnpm objectui:build` shallow-cloned objectui at the pinned SHA into `.cache/`, built it in 10 m 36 s, wrote `packages/console/dist` (63 MB), left `git status` clean, and `pnpm check:console-sha` then reported `✓ Console dist matches the objectui pin`. So the fix on the README side is one line.

## Expected

- The README's three-command flow either produces a Console or says in the same block that `pnpm objectui:build` is the extra step (and that it needs network or a `../objectui` checkout), matching `examples.mdx`.
- The boot warning names the remedy that works in the cwd it is printed from — for this repo, `pnpm objectui:build`.
- `GET /_console/` (and ideally `/`) on a composition with no Console answer with a short page or JSON that says the Console is not built and how to build it, instead of a bare `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

## Actual

The README omits the step, the warning sends the reader to a different repository's command, and the HTTP surface returns anonymous 404s.
